// A complete UV layout (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Texture_atlas): charts
// packed into the unit UV square at the texel resolution AtlasSize, the seams
// the unwrap introduced, and the padding (in texels) kept between charts to
// avoid bleeding.
type UvAtlas
    implements IValue
{
    Charts: Array<UvChart>;
    Seams: UvSeam;
    AtlasSize: IntegerSize2D;
    PaddingTexels: Integer;
}
